question: What authoritative teaching supports the claim that such distinctions lack intrinsic difference?
premises: Utpalaguru stated a principle about existent and nonexistent things.
The same principle applies to inert and non-inert things.
The principle denies an intrinsic difference in their own nature.
inference: It is ascertained that these opposed classes do not differ by their own intrinsic nature.
plain_english: As Utpalaguru said, just as the existent and the nonexistent have no intrinsic difference in their own nature, so too the inert and the non-inert do not; this is firmly established.
